testcase.name: Scenario: Dock left from an expanded Modify title: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:234:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock left from an expanded Modify title ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top ✔ And the unpinned Modify additional command area is open ✔ When the user chooses Left from Docking Positions on its title ✔ Then the ribbon is docked on the left ✔ And the Modify additional command area closes ✔ When the user opens Docking Positions from the left-docked ribbon ✔ Then Left is checked ✔ When the user chooses Top ✔ Then the ribbon returns to the top with the additional command area closed
